# Feature: Adaptive Content Width

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-10 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Layout and Journey screens must adapt to the **available main content width** (e.g. Cursor split panes), not only the window/viewport breakpoint — so primary UI stays usable without large empty gutters or horizontal clipping. Encode this as a shared adaptive API + governance in AGENTS.md, Adaptive UI contract, and UI styleguide.

## Preconditions
- Authenticated app shell with desktop or collapsed sidebar
- Journey surface using `AdaptivePage` (pilot: Session Join)
- Browser / IDE preview can be resized below full desktop width while still ≥768px viewport

## Happy Path
- [x] `resolveAdaptiveBand` / content helpers classify phone/tablet/desktop from a width in px (pure, testable)
- [x] Shell `<main>` exposes a named container (`@container/main` + `data-adaptive-main`) for content-width queries
- [x] `useAdaptiveContentBand` observes a container element (ResizeObserver) and returns the same bands as viewport helpers
- [x] Session Join primary column uses fluid width within the main pane (soft max-width, no forced side void when pane is narrow)
- [x] Adaptive UI contract documents content-width principle + gate `AU-CONTENT-WIDTH`
- [x] `docs/ui-styleguide.md` documents page-width / container rules for Journey screens
- [x] `AGENTS.md` requires content-width adaptive rules for new user-facing UI

## Edge Cases
- [x] Missing / zero-size container → band falls back safely (desktop or last known; no crash)
- [x] SSR / no window → hooks do not throw
- [x] Viewport phone band still collapses shell chrome (`md:`); content band does not fight mobile bottom nav

## Regression
- [x] Session Join create/join/past tabs still render and remain usable
- [x] Existing `useAdaptiveBand` viewport API unchanged for callers
- [x] Library / other AdaptivePage screens not broken by AdaptivePage class tweaks

## Assumptions
- Pilot is Session Join + shell main container; full app migration of every `max-w-*` screen is follow-up
- Soft max-width (~42rem) remains for readability on ultra-wide; on narrow main the column fills available width
- Architecture note lives in Adaptive UI contract (no separate architecture-freeze file required)

## Security Coverage
- F-01…F-05 / B-01…B-10: out of scope — presentation/layout only, no auth, UGC, or network changes
- P-01…P-06: N/A (no workers/secrets)
